root_cause: The content orchestrator used PostgREST maybeSingle() after an ordered limited query for the next decided publication. In production this path returned an error at select-pending and aborted the closed loop before publication dispatch.
prevention: Use deterministic array selection with explicit ordering and limit(1) for queue heads.
Treat empty result as NO_PENDING_ARTIFACT rather than an exception.
Log database error code/message/details for recoverable diagnostics.
Keep publication state fail-closed and let the canonical content loop retry after repair.
production_readback: Pending protected merge, Supabase function deployment/readback and closed-loop retry.
